description: Ticks off, unticks or partly covers lines on a shopping list ('I already have rice', 'I only need 200g more'). Takes shoppingListId, expectedRevision and changes keyed by line ID (excluded or coveredQuantity), all from get_shopping_list. Changes only what to buy; recipes and pantry are untouched. Repeating the same values is safe; a revision conflict means the list changed and get_shopping_list has the new revision. Requires a linked Chop it account. To add selected usual buys to this same list, send approved extras and the latest revision. These are additional quantities. Check for overlap with dinner lines first. Repeating the same extra is safe.

coveredQuantity.description: Amount already covered, in the list line unit. E.g. 100 of 400g leaves 300g to buy. Never guess unknown stock.

excluded.description: True means do not buy this line; false restores it.

extras.description: Household extras the shopper explicitly selected, with the amount to buy in addition to dinner requirements. Include distinguishing brands and pack sizes in the name. Ask about unknown quantities.

shoppingListId.description: The exact shopping list to read or update. Never infer the list from an old widget.

name: update_shopping_list

localStateAvailable.description: False for app-week reads: browser-only ticks, extras and serving overrides are unavailable.

title: Update your shopping list
